test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
In the following triads, each group of letters is related to the subsequent one following a certain logic. Select from the given options, the one which follows the same logic.

SWAP - WSAP - PAWS

ALSO - LASO - OSLA
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SWAP - WSAP - PAWS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3014673f852036582a9c0f606675c705dc503d8574578a00ed828c7c549564ea.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1539ab10b07c7bd8da0eb6503feb460a303d2313f87b0367bae9330d954fd4f1.png] 

And,

ALSO - LASO - OSLA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fda7fcd23e0eb9c4c1af86e544ab29b6d9664c6a28044ecfba4bc907184f2404.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7a83552759118e51ac6c53b8f3c645beab5bbdfc59c2e91b105f263bacbb2f3.png] 

Similarly,

USER - SUER - RESU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a78942c33e131e2439c2c8952e0e269df153f74d324a8fd707508e848c63bd9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d6e8e1466879d292ddbf5de9f5ed71b320b14861c598e552f558e5745b6111a.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
